Jordan —

Thanks for the packet and the clear asks. First-pass comments below (I'll put full redline in the tracker):

1) Data residency: we can accept a US-only residency sentence. I suggest the following short clause for Section 7: "Customer data will be stored in data centers located within the United States; Redwood Inference will not intentionally transfer customer data outside the United States without Customer's prior written consent." That's narrow and should satisfy procurement.

2) Liability cap: Brightline's redline increases the cap to 6x subscription fees (they asked). Recommend holding to our standard 3x cap; offering a limited carveout for gross negligence is acceptable.

3) Termination/Service credits: Their proposed termination-for-convenience language is broader than usual. We should propose a defined notice period (60 days) and pro-rate refunds for pre-paid reserved capacity.

4) Exhibit A / Signers: I agree — request a signer matrix if they have separate legal and procurement signatories. For speed, accept VP Finance as contract signatory but require an internal technical approver email on the order form (we can use Exhibit B acknowledgement). I'll add a line in the Order Form template that explicitly lists the "Contract Signatory" and "Technical Approver" fields.

I'll upload the redline and tracked changes to the intake ticket HS-5509123 today. Marissa — can you confirm billing contact details for the order form (name, email, billing address)? Jordan — I'll aim for a 2-business-day turnaround on a first-pass counter.

-Kim
